metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Kesari Ride (ride-hailing); Platform: Google Cloud asia-southeast1 (zones asia-southeast1-a/asia-southeast1-b/asia-southeast1-c); network range 10.150.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster kesari-prod-asiaso (GKE); pricing-svc is deployed with RollingUpdate (maxUnavailable 25%) and must run at full replica count during peak traffic; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which service or component is the origin of the failure?
Which change or automation run triggered the incident? Give its identifier.
Which version of the service introduced the defect?
Which configuration key did the new version fail on at startup?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
